# Teacher Freedom

> A resource hub empowering educators to understand their legal rights, union membership options, and professional freedom following the Janus v. AFSCME Supreme Court ruling.

Teacher Freedom advocates for educator awareness of First Amendment protections and alternatives to traditional union membership. The site provides guides, testimonials, and research on teacher rights, union opt-out options, and professional associations.

## Key Topics

- Union membership
- Teacher rights
- Janus v. AFSCME ruling
- First Amendment
- Union alternatives
- Professional associations
- Opt-out guides
- Educator advocacy
- Labor rights
- Union dues
- Employment law
- Teacher stories
- Agency fees
- Professional membership
- Liability insurance

## Core Information & Mission

- [Teacher Freedom: Know Your Union Membership Rights](https://teacherfreedom.org): Homepage introducing Teacher Freedom's mission on union membership rights and teacher advocacy.
- [Why? - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/why): Explanation of Teacher Freedom Project's mission and advocacy goals.
- [Educator Association Rights - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/educator-association-rights): Core page on educator rights following Janus v. AFSCME Supreme Court ruling.

## Teacher Rights & Legal Guides

- [10 Rights New Teachers Probably Don't Know They Have - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/10-rights-new-teachers-dont-know-they-have): Educational guide on ten essential rights for new teachers and union membership.
- [Take the Teacher Freedom Pledge - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/teacher-freedom-pledge): Interactive pledge affirming First Amendment rights and union membership freedom.
- [Top 5 Reasons Teachers Opt Out - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/top-5-reasons-teachers-opt-out): Guide explaining primary reasons educators choose to leave union membership.

## Union Alternatives & Professional Options

- [Teaching Benefits: Is the Teachers Union Your Only Option? - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/teacher-benefits-union-alternatives): Comparative guide on teacher benefits and union alternatives for educators.
- [Alternatives to Union Membership - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/alternatives-to-union-membership): Guide to non-union professional associations and alternative educator organizations.
- [Top 5 Reasons Teachers Join Alternatives - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/top-5-reasons-teachers-join-alternatives): Analysis of motivations for teachers choosing non-union professional associations.

## Research & Survey Data

- [One Year After Janus v. AFSCME - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/janus-anniversary-teacher-poll): Poll results analyzing teacher views one year after Janus v. AFSCME decision.
- [Educator Survey - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/teacher-rights-survey): Survey on educator awareness of legal rights post-Janus v. AFSCME ruling.
- [Survey Results - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/survey-results): National survey results on teacher union attitudes and contract negotiations.

## Educator Stories & Testimonials

- [Our Stories - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/our-stories): Collection of educator testimonials on union choice and professional freedom.
- [Andrea, special education teacher - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/story/andrea): Personal testimonial from special education teacher Andrea on union choice.
- [Christi, guidance counselor - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/story/christi): Story from guidance counselor Christi on choosing professional alternatives.
- [Damon, social studies teacher - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/story/damon): New Jersey social studies teacher Damon's experience with union alternatives.
- [Jim, music teacher - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/story/jim): Music teacher Jim's story on agency fees and union membership decisions.

## Resources & Support

- [Resources for Teachers - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/resources-for-teachers): Curated list of 150+ websites and resources for new and veteran educators.
- [Share Your Story - Teacher Freedom](https://teacherfreedom.org/share-your-story): Form for teachers to submit personal stories about union membership choices.
